lines.text: Samson sees a young Philistine woman in Timnah and asks his parents to get her for him as a wife.
In the vineyards of Timnah, a young lion comes roaring at Samson, and he tears it apart with his bare hands.
Samson finds a swarm of locusts and honey in the lion's carcass, eats some, and gives some to his parents.
The Philistines choose twelve men to accompany Samson, and he tells them a riddle with a bet of garments.
Samson goes down to Ashkelon, kills thirty men, and gives their clothes to those who solved the riddle.
